evals.prompt: This app uses @solidjs/router 2.0.0-next with solid-js 2.0. Write a route that reads a post with query() and a form that saves an edit, showing pending state while it submits.
evals.expected_output: Router 2 code: a query read through a core createMemo under Loading, a formAction for the form, and useSubmissions for pending state.
assertions: Does not use createAsync; reads the query with createMemo under a Loading boundary.
Uses formAction (not the deprecated router action) for the form.
Uses useSubmissions rather than useSubmission for pending UI.

evals.prompt: On @solidjs/router 2.0.0-next with solid-js 2, build a nav with Home, Users, and a user's Settings page link, highlight the current section, and preload a link's data when the user hovers it.
evals.expected_output: Plain anchors built from typed paths, CSS on data-active/aria-current, and intentPreload configured on createRouter.
assertions: Uses plain <a> elements, not an A component or activeClass.
Builds hrefs from the router's typed paths (for example paths.users(id).settings) or plain strings.
Styles active state with [data-active] or [aria-current="page"] selectors.
Configures preloadLinks: intentPreload() on createRouter instead of assuming hover preloading is on by default.

evals.prompt: Set up a new Solid 2 app with server-side rendering, a /api/health endpoint, server functions, and a typed DATABASE_URL secret. I was going to use SolidStart.
evals.expected_output: A start-mode setup: @solidjs/vite-plugin with start and ssr true and serverFunctions, a middleware module for the endpoint, and env.ts with a server schema read through virtual:env/server.
assertions: Uses @solidjs/vite-plugin start mode (start plus ssr: true) instead of adding @solidjs/start.
Implements /api/health in a start.middleware module that calls next() for other requests.
Declares DATABASE_URL in env.ts under server and reads it only from server-only code via virtual:env/server.
Does not hand-write index.html or a dev server script.

evals.prompt: In my Solid 2 start-mode app, clicking "add to cart" calls a saveCart server function, and every price on the page refetches each time. Why?
evals.expected_output: An explanation of the POST-as-mutation rule with respond(value, { revalidate: "" }) as the fix.
assertions: Explains that under @solidjs/router a POST server function with no revalidate keys revalidates every query on screen.
Returns respond(items, { revalidate: "" }) (or names the affected keys) from saveCart.
Does not suggest removing query() or disabling caching as the fix.
